name: Neloodony 4x6 Off White Fluffy Soft Shaggy Area Rug
description: Add cozy warmth to your space with this ultra-soft Neloodony 4x6 area rug in off-white! Crafted with a comfortable silk wool plush top layer, high-rebound memory cotton cushioning, and a secure non-slip woven backing to prevent sliding. It is highly versatile and perfect for bedrooms, living rooms, or dorm setups. Note: This item is pre-owned and has been thoroughly vacuumed, washed, and sanitized. Coming from a pet-friendly home with a resident cat, it has been meticulously cleaned, but please note it does NOT come with an additional storage retail bag. Local buyers should bring their own bag or hamper for transport.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled and ready to lay flat. Does NOT come with an additional storage bag; please bring your own hamper or bag for pickup. Meticulously cleaned, but comes from a pet-friendly student home with a cat.
meta_description: Shop the pre-owned Neloodony 4x6 feet off-white fluffy soft shag area rug. Washable silk wool with non-slip backing, perfect for bedroom or dorm rooms.
name_zh: Neloodony 4x6英尺 珍珠米白色超软加厚长毛绒地毯
description_zh: 低价出转让自用 Neloodony 4x6英尺（约1.2x1.8米）米白色长毛绒亲肤加厚地毯。上层为极度亲肤舒适的丝绒毛，中层带高回弹记忆棉夹层，底层为防滑编织设计，抓地力强不移位，赤脚踩上去极为解压。非常适合客厅、床边或宿舍增添温馨质感。本品已完成全方位清洗、深层吸尘与全面消毒，无顽固污渍。由于本人养猫，虽然上架前已经过彻底清洁，但衣物/织物类难免可能残留极轻微的微小毛发痕迹。请注意，本品不含原装零售收纳袋，同城自提的小伙伴请记得自行携带打包袋或脏衣篮来装运哦！
